title: Job 12
paragraphs: ¹ Then Job answered and said: ² "No doubt you are the people who matter, and wisdom will die with you. ³ But I have a mind as well as you — I am no less than you. Who does not know these things? ⁴ I have become a laughingstock to my friends — I, who called on God and he answered me, a just and blameless man who has become a laughingstock. ⁵ The one who is comfortable has contempt for misfortune — it is the fate of those whose feet are slipping.

⁶ The tents of robbers are at peace, and those who provoke God live securely — those whom God has given everything they want. ⁷ But ask the animals, and they will teach you; ask the birds of the sky, and they will tell you; ⁸ ask the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea explain it to you. ⁹ Which of all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this? ¹⁰ In his hand is the life of every living creature, and the breath of all mankind.

¹¹ Does the ear not test words, just as the tongue tastes food? ¹² Wisdom belongs to the aged, and understanding to those who have lived long. ¹³ But with God are wisdom and power; he has both counsel and understanding. ¹⁴ What he tears down cannot be rebuilt; whoever he shuts in cannot get out. ¹⁵ If he holds back the waters, they dry up; if he unleashes them, they overwhelm the land.

¹⁶ With him are strength and sound wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver both belong to him. ¹⁷ He leads counselors away stripped bare, and makes fools of judges. ¹⁸ He breaks off the chains that kings put on others, and ties a loincloth around their own waists. ¹⁹ He leads priests away stripped bare, and overthrows those who have stood firm for ages. ²⁰ He silences the lips of trusted advisors, and takes away the discernment of the elders.

²¹ He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong. ²² He uncovers deep things from the darkness and brings into the light the shadow of death. ²³ He makes nations great, then destroys them; he enlarges nations, then drives them away. ²⁴ He strips the understanding away from the leaders of the nations and makes them wander in a trackless waste. ²⁵ They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them stagger like drunkards.
